implementation: Windows 10 Home, Pro, Enterprise, Education, Windows 10 S Fall Creators Update and Windows Server, Windows Server Datacenter (version 1709); Cryptography Next Generation (CNG) Implementations
description: The Microsoft Windows Kernel Mode Cryptographic Primitives Library -- Cryptography Next Generation (CNG) -- is a general purpose, software-based, cryptographic module which provides FIPS 140-2 Level 1 cryptography.
